primer: PDS Limited (NSE: PDSL) is a ₹5,732 Cr asset-light global apparel sourcing platform that posted ₹13,110 Cr in FY26 sales and a record ₹4,432 Cr in Q2 FY27 (+30% YoY). The balance sheet flipped to ₹154 Cr net cash with -5 days working capital. However, vertical-head Minority Interests absorbed ~37.5% of TTM consolidated PAT, compressing owner ROE to 6.48%–7.43% alongside Ted Baker losses. Deducting a conservative 30% Minority Interest from FY28E consolidated PAT (₹353 Cr -> ₹247.1 Cr owner PAT) yields a ₹346.50 Base Case fair value at 20x P/E—below both CMP ₹405.10 and the ₹368.31–₹390.97 support zone. Our verdict is REJECTED on valuation until owner-attributable margins expand.
